description.text: Course Overview: Control Science and Engineering is a discipline that studies the theories, methods, technologies, and engineering applications of control. It is based on cybernetics, systems theory, and information theory, and focuses on common issues in various application fields, that is, in order to achieve control goals, how to establish system models, analyze internal and environmental information, and adopt what control and decision-making behaviors. This discipline is called "Automation" at the undergraduate level and "Control Science and Engineering" at the graduate level.

duration.text: The Surveying and Mapping at Chang'an University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2916 USD/per year ￥ 21000 CNY/per year

materials.text: On the application system of our university, applicants must fill in information in Chinese or English and submit application materials online.1. Valid Ordinary Passport.If the applicant is in China, a valid residence permit is also required.2. The highest degree certificate. Graduating students can provide a pre-graduation letter as a substitute, and have to bring the original certificate when they come to China.3. Transcripts.4. "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners"(Attachment 3).Applicants should strictly follow the items required in the "Physical Examination Records for Foreigners" and fill them out in Chinese or English. The “Physical Examination Record for Foreigners” missing pages or without a photo or a cross-page seal on it, or without a signature of physician or seal from hospital is invalid. Whereas the inspection results are valid in 6 months, applicants are requested to determine the time of their medical examination accordingly.5. Valid non-criminal record certificate within 6 months. If the applicant is already in China, she/he can only provide performance letter or Non-objection certificate from current university.6. Proof of Language Proficiency.7. Study Plan for Bachelor or Research Plan for Master and PhD.8. Two recommendation letters signed by (associate) professors (Undergraduate students are exempt).9. Conditional acceptance letter (It’s not a mandatory but a preferred file, with which students will be admitted in priority).10. Others preferred: academic achievements (important), certificates of sports or cultural activity.11. Students under 18 years old should upload Letter of Authorization.(Attachment 4)Note: Chinese or English translation copy is mandatory if original file is not in Chinese/English/Spanish.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health; 2. Requirements for the applicant's educational background and age: Those who are pursuing a bachelor's degree must have a high school diploma and be under the age of 25. (2) Those who are pursuing a master's degree must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35. (3) Those pursuing a doctoral degree must hold a master's degree and be under the age of 40. (4) Those pursuing non-degree education courses should be under the age of 45. 3. Not a recipient of any other scholarships. 4. Language proficiency requirements: IELTS >= 6.0, TOEFL > 80, MELAB >= 10
